node.statement: The original projection P is nonvanishing because | ||P||-1 |<=B epsilon_X=O(C_proj epsilon_X+epsilon_X). Its original-unit complement is nonvanishing because the reverse triangle inequality, rectified nontriviality, and unit closeness give | ||I_X-P||-1 |<=||I_X-J||+| ||J-P||-1 |<=(C_rect+B)epsilon_X=O(C_proj epsilon_X+epsilon_X). Together with the two C_proj epsilon_X-projection statements, def-delta-projection says that P_0:=P is nontrivial for the original product and original unit I_X. Since the algebra was arbitrary and C_proj,e_proj are universal, this proves the root contract.
